reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, is it really tested. At $24.99 for the first box, with a money-back guarantee, I can try one box without much risk.
objection: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles. A lab report tells me what is in the capsule, not whether it will do anything for me, and I might quit by day 10.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be missing or not matching my batch, or if the launch price were not available when I check out, I would skip it.
